summary: Short kerb at about 19% grade, with flats 11 m away.
reasons: Only 26 m, in a parked-car bend

best_section.where: North kerb on the bend below the tree-shaded driveway

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 11 m and 13 m away on the north side; more flats and houses 21-25 m beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; cars park along the kerb and in angle bays opposite, leaving little room.
drivers.convention: Parallel and angle parking is signed and cars use it.

sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over most of the kerb, from the north and east.
